name: Shadcn Builder
summary: No-code form builder for shadcn/ui: drag-and-drop fields, live preview and export of React + Tailwind CSS form code.
description: A browser-based no-code form builder for the shadcn/ui component library. Drag 20 form components — text, text area, number, email, password, file upload, telephone, URL, credit card, select, checkbox, radio group, date picker, switch and buttons — into a form, customise with a live preview and export clean typed React + Tailwind CSS code. Over 100 pre-built form templates. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui.
contains: 20 components (19 form + 1 content) per the components page
drag-and-drop, live preview, exported React + Tailwind CSS code
field types: text, textarea, number, email, password, file upload, telephone, URL, credit card
inputs: select, native select, checkbox, checkbox group, radio group, date picker, switch, submit and reset buttons
tech stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
